notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first search result was a separate entry "Code Vein 2" (id 1013131, slug code-vein-ii, 3 adds); the expected entry "Code Vein II" (id 1010947, slug code-vein-2, 35 adds) was put in its place. That entry lists no developer or publisher and only the genre Action; the other entry names Bandai Namco Entertainment. StrategyWiki has no page under "Code Vein II" or "Code Vein 2". codevein.fandom.com answers but has no page under either title; marked unverified. The Steam schema calls the app "Chronos" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2362060. 18 of 36 Steam achievements are hidden (1 to 17 and 36, the last named "A Hero's End"); all sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Hidden-achievement unlock rates run from about 35 to 70 percent, which suggests story progress rather than secrets, but this is not confirmed.
